body:
## Context
Issue #626: `shellIsPositivelyReadOnly` in `packages/core/lib/shell.mjs` classifies `adlc (hollow-test|rails-guard|flail-detector|preflight)` commands as positively read-only even when `--record` is passed (`adlc flail-detector ... --record` or `adlc rails-guard ... --record`), which appends an entry to the manifest ledger.

## Changes
1. Update `shellIsPositivelyReadOnly` in `packages/core/lib/shell.mjs` so any segment carrying `--record` (or `--record=...`) is not classified as positively read-only.
2. Run `node scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs` to propagate the updated shell classifier to `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/generated-shell.mjs` and `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/generated-shell.mjs`, and run `npm run build:cursor-mcp` to update `plugins/adlc-cursor/bin/adlc-mcp-wrapper.bundle.mjs`.
3. Update `packages/core/test/shell.test.mjs` and `packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs` to assert `--record` is rejected by `shellIsPositivelyReadOnly` while read-only invocations without `--record` remain allowed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `shellIsPositivelyReadOnly` returns `false` for `adlc flail-detector build.log --record --ticket T1` and `adlc rails-guard --ticket T1 --record --json`, and `true` for the same commands without `--record`. Verify: `node --test packages/core/test/shell.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC2: Generated hook twins and bundles stay in sync with `@adlc/core`. Verify: `node scripts/ticket-readers/generate.mjs --check && node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/shell-drift.test.mjs packages/runner/test/codex-integration.test.mjs plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: fix(core): reject --record in shellIsPositivelyReadOnly and sync hook twins (#626)
